D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/FiniteLayerProject.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Algebra.FiniteLayerProjectionEscape.finite_layer_projection_escape
D5/S3/Quantum/Algebra/FiniteLayerProject.signature: theorem finite_layer_projection_escape (S : Submodule 𝕜 V) [IsClosed (S : Set V)] (hResidual : Sᗮ ≠ ⊥) : ∃ e : V, e ∈ Sᗮ ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ S.starProjection e = 0 ∧ Metric.infDist e (S : Set V) = 1 ∧ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 V - S.starProjection‖ = 1
